function.name: number_analysis_prime_factors
function.description: Compute the prime factors of a number. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning: The user wants the prime factors of 123456. We can compute them. Let's do it manually or quickly. 123456 is even, divide by 2: 61728. Divide by 2: 30864. Divide by 2: 15432. Divide by 2: 7716. Divide by 2: 3858. Divide by 2: 1929. So 123456 = 2^6 * 1929. Now factor 1929. 1929 mod 3: sum digits 1+9+2+9=21, divisible by 3, so divide by 3: 1929/3=643. So 1929 = 3 * 643. 643 is prime? Check divisibility: sqrt(643) ~ 25.3. Check primes up to 23: 5 no, 7: 7*91=637, remainder 6; 11: 11*58=638, remainder 5; 13: 13*49=637, remainder 6; 17: 17*37=629, remainder 14; 19: 19*33=627, remainder 16; 23: 23*27=621, remainder 22. So 643 is prime. So prime factorization: 2^6 * 3 * 643. So prime factors: 2, 3, 643. But if we want all prime factors with multiplicity: 2 appears 6 times, 3 once, 643 once. So answer: 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 3, 643. Or just list unique primes: 2, 3, 643. The user asked "找出數字123456的質因數" which means "find the prime factors of the number 123456".
